text:
incident-bot: PAGE: sev2 — embedder latency spike in eu-west-1. Error rate up ~2%, tail latency >2s. Pager routed to #oncall :rotating_light:

maria_oncall: taking pager, stepping in. starting smoke checks and checking autoscale.

jake_sre: ping — any obvious config churn? KV cache TTLs maybe?
maria_oncall: no config deploys in the last hour. seeing a burst of cold-boot misses on prefix cache. attaching quick log extract.

jorge_engineering: ```
2024-11-02T15:07:03Z embedder-01 request_id=abc123 latency=2145ms cache_hit=false prefix_key=usr:embed:42
2024-11-02T15:07:04Z embedder-02 request_id=abc124 latency=1987ms cache_hit=false prefix_key=usr:embed:43
```

sam_devops: moving to scale out embedder pool by +2 nodes now. should absorb the burst if autoscaler is behind.
maria_oncall: thanks — scaling now. also flipping fallback routing to variant-b (lower mem, slightly slower quality) for requests > 1s to reduce queueing.

helen_pm: customer impact? do we need to notify any customers/customercare?
jake_sre: based on metrics, ~2% of production requests saw >=1s extra latency and ~0.5% saw errors (5xx) during the 10m window. most customers unaffected but a few high-throughput customers saw degraded p95.

leo_prodops: @helen_pm recommend targeted outreach for 3 enterprise customers hitting >5% error bucket, and a proactive note on status page if duration >30m.
maria_oncall: agreed. opening incident status update now. I'll add impacted customer list in the status update. :pencil2:

incident-bot: ACTIONS: page acknowledged by maria_oncall. mitigation in progress. create postmortem thread after resolution.

maria_oncall: mitigation: scale +2 completed, fallback routing toggled, cache-warming job queued to repopulate prefixes. observed p95 latency drop from ~2.4s -> 420ms after actions. error rate trending back to baseline.

jake_sre: can we root-cause to a cache eviction storm? any automated eviction job run?

jorge_engineering: seems like a coordinated TTL expiry on a subset of prefix keys — TTL aligned across many keys due to legacy batching in our cache warmer. warming job will help but we should change TTL jitter.

helen_pm: ok once stable let's schedule a 90m postmortem. prefer tomorrow 10am UTC if people available. need: timeline, RCA, customer impact, action items, owners, and sizing.

maria_oncall: 10am UTC works for me. jake/jorge/sam can you make it?
jake_sre: yes. sam_devops: yes.

leo_prodops: Q: severity mapping to remediation priority — do we treat this as P1 or P2 for remediation backlog? It caused customer-visible p95 regressions but short lived.

helen_pm: given sustained customer impact on multiple enterprise accounts, classify as P1 remediation but with short lead time — we need quick fix (config/jitter) and a follow-up engineering change.

maria_oncall: proposed action items (quick bullets):
- AI1: Add TTL jitter to prefix cache warmer and re-run (owner: jorge_engineering) — estimate: 1d (small)
- AI2: Improve cache warming priority and add circuit-breaker for mass-evict patterns (owner: jake_sre) — estimate: 3d (medium)
- AI3: Run a focused load test against embedder with cold-cache scenarios and validate autoscaler thresholds (owner: sam_devops) — estimate: 2d (small)
- AI4: Outreach to impacted customers + status page update (owner: helen_pm) — estimate: 1d (small)
- AI5: Add an alert for >0.5% error rate sustained 5m for embedder (owner: leo_prodops) — estimate: 1d (small)

jorge_engineering: I can start AI1 after standup. tagging the config change as hotfix with rollback plan.

jake_sre: AI2 I'd flag as medium but high priority — needs code changes and test coverage.

helen_pm: to tie this into planning: mark AI2 as Q2 sprint-2 candidate and tag it with OKR: "Improve inference reliability". AI1/3/5 are hotfixes and should be scheduled immediately.

leo_prodops: request: when creating tickets please include labels: severity/P1, component/embedder, postmortem-linked=1725556789, quarter=Q2. I'll reserve 5 story points in sprint-2 for AI2.
maria_oncall: will create tickets now.

sam_devops: quick note — autoscaler had a 90s cooldown; we should consider lowering for embedder to avoid tail build-up. adding as AI6 (owner: sam_devops) estimate: 2d (medium).

maria_oncall: handoff to next oncall in 30m — @jake_sre will take live mitigation ownership after I log off. I will post handoff note in #oncall-handoffs.
jake_sre: noted, will take over and follow up with ticket ownership for AI2 if needed.

helen_pm: booking postmortem: 2024-11-03 10:00 UTC, 90m. calendar invite sent to participants. please add pre-reads (metrics + timeline) to the doc.

maria_oncall: final status: system stable, p95 returned to baseline, warming job running. creating tickets and documenting timeline.

maria_oncall: SUMMARY (action items & owners):
- AI1 (hotfix) — TTL jitter on cache warmer — jorge_engineering — due: 2024-11-04 — size: 1d — label: P1
- AI2 (remediation) — caching circuit-breaker + priority changes — jake_sre — due: 2024-11-18 (Q2 sprint-2) — size: 3d — label: P1
- AI3 (validation) — load test cold-cache scenarios — sam_devops — due: 2024-11-06 — size: 2d
- AI4 (comms) — customer outreach + status page — helen_pm — due: 2024-11-04 — size: 1d
- AI5 (monitoring) — error-rate alert — leo_prodops — due: 2024-11-05 — size: 1d
- AI6 (autoscaler cooldown) — sam_devops — due: 2024-11-12 — size: 2d — tag for backlog if not ready for sprint

maria_oncall: tagging postmortem doc as postmortem/1725556789 and will link tickets. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

jake_sre: taking over live watch. will update once I have hotfix rollout status.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (mitigation stable). Postmortem scheduled.
